name: jev-mod
description: A cheap decision model picks each turn's skill, model and effort, compacts on request, and withholds injected text

api_key.title: Decision backend key
api_key.description: Your key for the provider below (TypeSafe unless you pick another). Kept in your OS's secure storage and handed only to this mod, never to the conversation. Leave empty to use a key in the environment or one jev-skills stored.

provider.title: Provider for that key
provider.description: Who answers the decisions with the key above: TypeSafe, or Jev through OpenRouter, Venice or OpenCode Zen.

backend_api_key.title: Named backend key
backend_api_key.description: The key for the decision server named as default in ~/.config/jev/backends.json, if you use one. Kept in secure storage.

routing.title: Routing
routing.description: Each turn's model and effort from the decision model's lane. off: every turn runs as Claude Code sends it.

skills.title: Skill suggestions
skills.description: default: what jev-skills' `jev switches` set, or on if it set nothing. shadow: ask and count, change nothing.

screening.title: Screening
screening.description: default: what jev-skills' `jev switches` set, or on if it set nothing. shadow: ask and count, change nothing.

private.title: Private
private.description: Send nothing to the decision backend: no routing or skill suggestions, and fetched text is screened with local patterns only.
